Family History

Discover your roots and connect with your ancestors through FamilySearch.

Discover where you come from

Have you ever wondered who your great-grandparents were? Where did your family come from? Family history lets you discover fascinating stories about your ancestors and better understand who you are.

We offer free help so you can research your genealogy using FamilySearch, the largest genealogy platform in the world.

What is FamilySearch?

  • A 100% free platform with more than 8 billion historical records
  • Access to birth, marriage and death records and more from all over the world
  • Tools to build your family tree online
  • Special collections of historical records from Spain and Latin America

How can we help you?

  • Creating your free FamilySearch account
  • Searching for records of your ancestors
  • Building your family tree step by step
  • Interpreting old historical documents
  • Connecting with relatives you didn't know existed

Why does family history matter?

Knowing your family history gives you a sense of identity and belonging. Research shows that people who know their family's story have greater resilience, self-esteem and sense of purpose.

For us, family is eternal. We believe family ties do not end with death, and family history lets us honor and remember those who came before us.

Start your search

Contact us and we will help you discover your family history for free.
